schemaMatches.quantity: per-page 4x4 receiver visibility submasks (2x2 texels of 16 bits per page)
mathTerms: one 16-bit word per page quadrant; 4 quadrants = 2x2 texels
gaps: Receiver masks are visibility hints for prefiltered distant pages, NOT variance/shadow moments.
The page->texel mapping is 2x2 (not two consecutive linear dwords); use uint2 addressing.
Final capture reports NumMips=8; the 4x4 submasks are per page-table mip and the 2x2-texel-per-page addressing applies to the selected mip.

fields.name: ReceiverSubMaskBit
fields.decode: mask address: page texel base=(2*pageX,2*pageY); quadrant=(vx>>6 & 1, vy>>6 & 1); sub=((vx>>4)&3, (vy>>4)&3); bit = 1 << (sub.y*4+sub.x)
